title: Mixed Event — Bustling Cafe ●REC! — Episode7 Triumphant Feast

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP!'s latest gig is a TV segment on location at a popular cafe! Little do they realize, it's none other than the cafe where Minori works!

rows.Line: carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All finished☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: These Mount Everest parfaits were so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Not only were they beautifully presented, but the service we received was wonderful. We'll have to start coming here more often.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you very much!
I'm glad you enjoyed our cafe so much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna try something new next time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
See you later, Mizuki!
Thanks for the yummy parfaits!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
See you!
I'm glad you enjoyed everything!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu and her sister sounded really happy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm glad I worked so hard on decorating them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Also...
I think our special guests are about to call it a wrap.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
And...that's a wrap!
Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line: Wow, we ended up sticking around for the whole thing. We should probably pay and get outta here.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Thank you very much for coming today, Ms. Fujin. Also, I apologize for how hectic things got back there.

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line:
No, please.
We should be the ones thanking you! We honestly couldn't get enough of your delicious sweets!

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line:
And thank you, MORE MORE JUMP!
This shoot ended up being really fun.

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line:
Anyway, thank you for having us!
We'll be back again soon!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
A lot happened, but we somehow managed!

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
I appreciate all your hard effort.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you for having us today.
This shoot really did end up being a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry we deviated from the script so much. I hope everything is going to be okay...!

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line:
Okay? You can't write this kind of stuff!
Our viewers especially love it when things get a little hectic or out of control.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: And how lucky are we that THE Fujin just happened to be here today? She gave us quite a long interview, but the staff should be able to splice together the best parts...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: Also, Momoi, you were very impressive...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Me...?

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: Yes. I've heard from others in the biz that you're good, but you really stood out today.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: You always seem to know where the cameras are and have this uncanny talent for scoring great footage... But above all else, you're a total pro when it comes to improvising.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: You made this amazing segment happen, so I hope you're looking forward to seeing it on TV.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: Anyway, we should start cleaning and packing up... None of you need rides or anything, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
We all live fairly close to here.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line:
In that case, please get home safe.
We may meet again for another show, so I'll be looking forward to working with you all again then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course! Again, thank you for having us today!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sounds like their shoot went really well...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And that staff member just gave Airi a ton of praise!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Not only that...
But she saved us while her shoot was still going on.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy Everyday really is the best!
After closing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All together now!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Mizuki
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad you're letting us stay for your after-party, but I still feel kinda bad...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Nonsense! All of you at MMJ helped get us over the line!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Especially you, Momoi.
Thank you for introducing such a wonderful person to fill in.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, please. You're giving me far too much credit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. All I did was ask, but I'm glad Mizuki ended up being the right person for the job.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, you were amazing! I still can't believe this was your first time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even when we became swamped with orders, you kept this cafe's motto in mind!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This cafe's motto?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, about giving each plate the love it deserves? Yeah, that rang pretty true with me...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I kept an eye on what our customers were being served during our shoot, and you certainly deserve full marks for presentation.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I've seen part-timers who've been working here for years cut corners to get by when things get busy...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: But you didn't waver when it got as crazy as it did today. So, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe... You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Also... I'd like to take this opportunity to thank you once more, MMJ.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Not only was I blown away by how you found ways to keep this cafe running smoothly during that shoot, you managed to send all our customers home smiling as well.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: It really reminded me of what idols are capable of...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: That's why I'm now officially a fan of MMJ!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Boss...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: To be perfectly honest, Minori, I was devastated when you told me that you'd be quitting to work full-time as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: But those feelings evaporated as I watched you work today. So, do your best! You'll always have my support...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I will!
Thank you for being so kind!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'm so happy for you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Now, I believe it's my turn to roll up these sleeves and get to work in the kitchen for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, does this mean you're gonna cook for us?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Boss not only makes amazing sweets, but is also an amazing cook!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, after making so many, I'm really wondering what one of those Mount Everest parfaits tastes like.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Ah, in that case, feel free to make one for yourself. You know the drill, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, I wanna help make it!
Let's split one between us♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to help out as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Can we be of assistance in any way?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: It's okay for you to all stay in your seats... But I might just have to take you up on your offer.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Let's cook something together! That should be fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, this can be both an after-party and a cooking party.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. This day just keeps getting better and better!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, let's get down to business and start whipping up some delicious food!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!
